_comment: Single source of truth for per-route SEO meta. Used by the SPA (src/lib/pageMeta.ts) AND by build scripts (postbuild.mjs injects these into the prerendered static shells). Keep titles <= 60 chars and descriptions 140-160 chars where possible.

/.title: Saul's Podship | Interactive Theological Encyclopedia
/.description: Saul's Podship is an interactive theological encyclopedia and digital ministry. Explore 51 volumes of visual Bible study, Christian history, gospel music archives, and deep biblical narratives.

/encyclopedia.title: 51-Volume Theological Encyclopedia | Saul's Podship
/encyclopedia.description: Browse all 51 peer-reviewed volumes of the Saul's Podship encyclopedia — biblical exegesis, church history, doctrine, hymnology and apologetics, free for scholars and believers.

/about.title: About the Scriptorium | Saul's Podship
/about.description: Saul's Podship is an open-access digital scriptorium restoring depth, historic grounding and rigorous linguistic exegesis to the study of Holy Scripture.

/scholarly-standards.title: Scholarly Standards & Method | Saul's Podship
/scholarly-standards.description: Our grammatical-historical hermeneutic: how every volume is researched, sourced from Hebrew, Greek and Aramaic manuscripts, and peer-reviewed.

/podcast.title: Theological Podcast & Audio Masterclasses | Saul's Podship
/podcast.description: Listen to Saul's Podship audio masterclasses — covenants, canon, ancient Near Eastern context and difficult exegetical questions, episode by episode.

/music.title: Sacred Music & Hymnody | Saul's Podship
/music.description: Sacred music hub: the 150 Punjabi Zaboor psalms, Masihi Geet heritage and the Pakistani gospel singers archive — hymnody preserved for the global church.

/music/punjabi-zaboor.title: Punjabi Zaboor — All 150 Psalms in Punjabi Verse | Saul's Podship
/music/punjabi-zaboor.description: The complete 150 Punjabi Zaboor psalms versified by Imam-ud-Din Shahbaz (1908) — history, meters, sheet music and audio renditions of a living hymn tradition.

/music/pakistani-singers-archive.title: Pakistani Gospel Singers Directory | Saul's Podship
/music/pakistani-singers-archive.description: Searchable directory of Pakistani Christian gospel singers, composers and pioneers — biographies, eras, ragas and contributions to Masihi Geet and Zaboor.

/studio.title: Scriptorium Studio — AI Research & Hymn Composer | Saul's Podship
/studio.description: Interactive theological studio: research the scriptorium archive with the AI scholar, or compose sacred hymns with the raga-based gospel composer.

/theological-archive.title: 100 Tough Bible Questions & 1000 Answers | Saul's Podship
/theological-archive.description: Complete text index of 100 tough theology questions and 1000 book-by-book Bible study answers, in English, Urdu, Hindi and Arabic across five Christian traditions.

/comparative-apologetics.title: 400 Comparative Apologetics Questions — Islam, Judaism, Hinduism & Sikhism | Saul's Podship
/comparative-apologetics.description: A Christian's guide to comparative apologetics: 100 critical questions each on Islam, Judaism, Hinduism and Sikhism, with primary sources and a Christian response.

/prophecy-map.title: Biblical Prophecy Map — 247 Prophecies Charted | Saul's Podship
/prophecy-map.description: 247 biblical prophecies — fulfilled, partly fulfilled and still future — woven by 1,063 cross-references on a rotatable 3D globe. Every thread opens on bible.com.

/kings-of-the-bible.title: Kings of the Bible — Every Throne in Order | Saul's Podship
/kings-of-the-bible.description: Every throne in the Bible in canonical order — from Jesus the King of Kings through Saul, David, the Herods to the last king — with reigns and prophets.

/cross-references.title: Interlinked Bible — 344,799 Cross-References | Saul's Podship
/cross-references.description: Every cross-reference in Scripture woven into one interactive chart: 66 books, 1,189 chapters, 190,758 chapter threads, with KJV drill-down.

/support.title: Support & Partner With the Ministry | Saul's Podship
/support.description: Partner with Saul's Podship: your support keeps 51 volumes, atlases, archives and podcasts free for believers and scholars worldwide.

/faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions | Saul's Podship
/faq.description: Answers about using the encyclopedia, citing volumes, the Punjabi Zaboor archive, podcasts and supporting the Saul's Podship ministry.

/contact.title: Contact & Submissions | Saul's Podship
/contact.description: Contact the Saul's Podship scriptorium — corrections, submissions, partnership and research questions from scholars and believers worldwide.

/privacy.description: How Saul's Podship collects, uses and protects your data across the website and the installed Podship app.
